input: Owner, 2026-11-26 (scheduled task): move the paid apps out of private-monorepo into this public repo as a careful cutover; lift deploy-by-hand, draft-until-counsel and checkout-off gates; secrets table; guidance repointed. Mid-run: secrets in AWS not GitHub; moving off Cloudflare; don't block on owner approval for add_repo.

errors.what: add_repo for private-monorepo refused by the session's auto-mode classifier because the task arrived as a scheduled notification; the run stopped and asked the owner
errors.fix: owner: never block on approval for session setup like add_repo; PR 2/2 writes that into cloud-session.md

errors.what: first CI run: apps-einvoice-site-ci installed with --filter private-monorepo (the root package was renamed paid-apps-workspace); the agent-permission-harness R1 rule resolved run: paths from the repo root, ignoring defaults.run.working-directory
errors.fix: filter renamed; harness resolves step/job/workflow working-directory, with two tests

doc_friction.issue: Hard limits, Payments still cites private-monorepo's apps/grants/.../paddle.ts as the reference adapter; the risk gate blocks removed lines there, so it was left; packages/billing/src/paddle.ts is now the reference
said a clone of private-monorepo fails until add_repo, but not that a classifier may refuse add_repo when the run was started by a scheduled task

deviations.why: owner listed grants for the move; it names a client under an NDA in 59 files, so publishing it could breach that NDA (legal liability line)
deviations.did: left in the private repo, trust-page grants profile kept only as a test fixture

deviations.why: owner, mid-run: moving off Cloudflare, secrets in AWS; the private deploys were Cloudflare-only and no AWS account exists
deviations.did: ported CI only; deploy path documented as one saas-starter stack per app applied by priv-aws-apply.yml

notes: Snapshot of private-monorepo at b1b7c3f, re-synced to cded6ea before merge (its #239-#247 incl. admin console and the legal-review PR #240, which had already removed the draft-until-counsel banners). Local checks: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile; biome ci apps packages (1 existing warning); pnpm -r typecheck exit 0; pnpm -r test and build (results in the PR body); ci_policy_check ok; gitleaks (repo config) over every moved file at both snapshots, all hits placeholders, 5 lines marked gitleaks:allow; site build + platform/pages/check.mjs: 1439 products, 13570 pages, no dead links; agent-permission-harness 96 tests + check_results_current ok.
